featured_reviews.name: Phiroze Lakhani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr Milan Balakrishna has been a  huge blessing for us. My 63 year old deaf & mute uncle is suffering from bipolar disorder since the past 2 decades. Earlier, we used to take medication from another senior psychiatrist from Masina (he is no longer with Masina now). But after couple of years we faced severe side effects and my uncle got seriously ill. He even had to get admitted to the  ICU. Once he recovered, we started looking for another doctor. We tried several other doctors' medication but looking at my uncle's age and recent history of side effects, no-one was able to help us much. Consequently, uncle's aggression & violence also increased day by day.

This is when we came to know about Dr Milan Balakrishna. By the grace of Almighty, with couple of session with my uncle he designed a very balanced medication for him. Now my deaf and mute uncle is totally independent & cooperative since 4 years! Unlike earlier, we don't require any 24x7 caretaker for him. He is doing all his day to day activities very well on his own. Also he is taking medicines willingly and regularly. May God bless Dr Balakrishna for his excellent counseling and treatment. He has been successful handling our case since 4 years now without any issues. He is truly a gem of a doctor.

Sometimes it’s about carrying things alone that were meant to be shared. It’s the balance of many small environments you live inside.

Burnout doesn’t always look dramatic.

Sometimes it looks like:
• Feeling tired even after resting  
• Losing motivation for things you once enjoyed

Burnout is your mind asking for care, not criticism.
